title: AI Team Headshots for Your About Page | AIVideosUGC
description: Make matching team headshots in one shared light, crop and backdrop, each from a teammate's own photo. AI portraits for About and team pages.
h1: AI Team Headshots That Match, from Founder to New Hire
lead: Mismatched team photos make an About page feel unfinished. Create a shared headshot look from each teammate's own approved photo.

steps.d: Upload an approved face-and-shoulders photo with even light. Confirm the business use before upload.
Describe the backdrop, crop, light and clothing once and reuse the brief. Each portrait keeps a personal face.
Download matching portraits for your team page, deck or profiles, with no studio day. Add names and roles as text on your page.

maker.upload_title: Drop a photo of the person here

faq.a: Use a recent face-and-shoulders photo with even light and no hat, sunglasses or hand covering the face.

faq.q: How can a team page feel consistent?
faq.a: A shared backdrop, crop and light gives every portrait one visual system while each person keeps their own features.

faq.q: Can I add names in the headshot?
faq.a: Add names and job titles as editable text beside each image, so the portrait stays easy to update.

faq.q: What if I need a headshot of a specific person exactly?
faq.a: The output follows the uploaded person’s visible features, but it is not an official identity document. Let the person review it before publishing.

faq.q: How much do team headshots cost?
faq.a: Each portrait costs 24 credits, and the total scales with the number of teammates. The current cost appears before creation.

faq.q: How do I publish team portraits safely?
faq.a: Get each person’s approval for the portrait and the page where it will appear. Keep names and roles as editable text.

faq.q: Do I need permission from each teammate?
faq.a: Yes. Use a photo approved for this business use, show the finished portrait to its owner and remove it if they ask.

faq.q: Can I use the headshots beyond the About page?
faq.a: Yes. With each person’s approval, downloads can be used on LinkedIn, pitch decks, speaker bios and other business materials.

faq.q: Can each teammate approve the final portrait?
faq.a: Yes. Show each person the finished portrait and get approval for the page or material where it will appear before publishing.

faq.q: Can I use the portraits in a pitch deck?
faq.a: Yes. With the person’s approval, use the downloaded portrait in a pitch deck, speaker bio or other business material.

faq.q: Can a new hire match an existing team set?
faq.a: Yes. Use an approved face-and-shoulders photo and the same backdrop, crop and light brief, then let the new hire review the result.

cta_lead: Upload one clear photo of the person. See the cost before you start.

steps.prompt: Make a square portrait from the uploaded person with a soft gray backdrop and even light.
